label: iconn_globalalts_2025_future_of_ai
source: iConnections Global Alts 2025 — The Future of AI

results.summary: Cheaper AI inference via DeepSeek-style efficiency will massively increase AI ROI and accelerate deployment phase
results.quote: intelligence just got a lot cheaper... massively increase the ROI on AI
results.evidence: The moderator says 'give us your take' and the response begins 'sure um I actually spoke to Brad' — this reply voice continues through the DeepSeek analysis including the ROI framing, and Baker is the named panelist being addressed.

results.summary: America is in a 1996-analog moment: deregulation + AI + fiscal reform = multiple years of 5%+ real GDP growth
results.quote: we're in 1996... multiple years of 5% plus real GDP growth in America
results.evidence: The transcript window does not extend far enough to show the 1996/GDP quote in context; both Baker and Antonio Gracias are panelists and no speaker cue distinguishes who said it.

results.summary: We are in year 3 of a decade-long AI infrastructure supercycle analogous to the 1990s PC/client-server boom
results.quote: year three of AI... compounded at 40% per year for a decade
results.evidence: The transcript window does not reach the 'year three of AI' quote and no speaker marker or direct address cue identifies whether Baker or Gracias said it.

results.summary: Foundation model companies without proprietary data will become commodities, validated by DeepSeek R1
results.quote: any model that didn't have proprietary data was basically going to become a commodity
results.evidence: The host attributes the prior-year thesis to 'you guys' (both Baker and Gracias), then Baker responds 'sure um I actually spoke to Brad' — the long analytical passage follows but no speaker marker distinguishes Baker from Gracias within it; however the opening 'sure um I actually spoke to Brad' reads as Baker's voice continuing, making this likely Baker but not certain given no explicit marker.

results.summary: DeepSeek R1 de-risks AI by revealing two new scaling laws beyond pre-training, extending the AI investment runway 5-10 years
results.quote: this is not ending anytime in the next 5 to 10 years because of these two new scaling laws
results.evidence: The extended monologue beginning 'sure um I actually spoke to Brad' through the two new scaling laws passage is a continuous block; later text says 'I agree with Gavin' and 'to add to what Gavin said', confirming the preceding analytical content was Baker's.

results.summary: xAI has the highest return on capital in AI data centers among Western companies and will maintain this advantage
results.quote: xai has the highest Trend Capital certainly in the west
results.evidence: The passage 'we believe xcii has the highest Trend Capital certainly in the west' is preceded by 'to add to what Gavin said' and uses 'we at Valor', identifying the speaker as Gracias (Valor), not Baker (Atreides).

results.summary: Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) event horizon has been pulled forward; 90% probability it is net positive for humanity
results.quote: that event horizon has been pulled forward... 90% chance that's awesome for Humanity
results.evidence: The ASI event-horizon passage ('my biggest takeaway is that event horizon has been pulled forward... 90% chance') appears in the continuous Baker monologue before Gracias interjects with 'to add to this... if I was in a GPU financing business'; turn alternation places this with Baker.

results.summary: GPU financing businesses face significant asset value risk given DeepSeek's demonstration of equivalent workloads on cheaper chips
results.quote: if I was in a GPU financing business I would be very worried right now
results.evidence: 'If I was in a GPU financing business which I am not I would be very worried right now' follows immediately after 'to add to this' by the speaker who then references 'we at Valor', identifying Gracias as the speaker.

results.summary: AI infrastructure stocks may face choppy Q1 2025 due to product transitions and DeepSeek uncertainty, but H2 2025 could replicate 2023-2024 performance
results.quote: choppy first quarter for infrastructure providers... last nine months a rerun of 2024 and 2023
results.evidence: The prediction is introduced with 'Gavin's stories are true' addressing Baker just before, and the choppy-Q1/H2-rerun prediction is then delivered in first person with the 1999 career-entry anecdote ('when I came into this business it was 1999'), a self-identification consistent with Baker's known background.

results.summary: 2025 is the year of AI applications — software and internet companies will be primary beneficiaries of higher AI ROI
results.quote: software and internet did really really well... higher AI ROI
results.evidence: 'Software and internet did really really well' appears in the continuous Baker monologue in T12's window, before Gracias interjects with 'to add to this'; turn alternation places this observation with Baker.

results.summary: 2025 is the year humanoid robotics becomes credibly real in public perception, with 2026 seeing consumer deployment
results.quote: I'm going to have a humanoid robot the Optimus robot in my house in 2026
results.evidence: 'I'm going to have a humanoid robot the Optimus robot in my house in 2026' is a personal first-person retail-style prediction; it follows Baker's prediction and is then responded to by a voice saying 'I 100% agree', with Baker separately saying 'I expect an Optimus robot at Global alt', indicating the house-in-2026 line was Gracias's, not Baker's.

results.summary: DeepSeek's release timing (4 days after Stargate announcement) was likely deliberate geopolitical signaling designed to chill American AI investment
results.quote: do not think it was a coincidence that this came out 4 days after the $500 billion Stargate
results.evidence: The passage begins 'May I just to kind of keep riffing um and I agree with all of that' — this is a speaker agreeing with the prior Gracias turn and then adding the Stargate coincidence point; 'I've been in markets for 25 years' is a self-identification consistent with Baker's career timeline, and Gracias had just finished speaking.

results.summary: China's DeepSeek achievement raises serious questions about whether the chip embargo has been circumvented or rendered irrelevant
results.quote: the Embargo was broken possibly true... or a different architecture of some kind
results.evidence: The embargo analysis ('the Embargo was broken possibly true... or a different architecture') appears in a passage that references 'we at Valor' and 'I have said very publicly that the models are biased with the values of their creators', consistent with Gracias's voice before Baker interjects with 'May I just keep riffing'.
